about: 0130 A1-A2: when a Haiku `same` on two entity names merges by itself. Measured 2026-11-07 on 277 labelled pairs Haiku called the same: the lab's experiment 2 (dev 70, test 92, test2 65; two blind Opus labellers and a referee) and the owner's queue answers (50). A row is automatic only when its right/n meets the bar; every other `same` stays in the review queue. Change a row here, not the code (markx/identity.py reads it).

second.about: A held-back `same` whose every reason has a second row that is on, at >= min_conf, is asked again: the same guide (alias-v1) with two other example posts per name. Both `same` at >= min_conf: automatic, with its redirect (undoable). A disagreement stays in the queue, marked. Measured: these merges 71/71 right (held out of the guide's writing: 64/64), against alias-v2 (a stricter second-opinion guide) 78/79.

rule_type.about: v10.18: a pair a name rule (squash, maker_prefix, handle, anchor, fields) proposes across two types (or an org and a product family) is Haiku's to decide: asked when unasked; Haiku's answer in apart_relations at >= apart_min_conf keeps it apart by itself (its open queue item closed, kept); any other not-`same` (part, other_version, cant_tell, or a lower confidence) stays queued (haiku_unsure); `same` is held as any `same` with a type mismatch. Measured 2026-11-14 on the server's 304 open rule-proposed items (Haiku asked on the 281 never asked; one blind labeller, disputes refereed): `different` >= 0.8 kept apart 160/160 right (Wilson 97.7-100%); `part` >= 0.8 10/16 (a company and its same-name product: often one page), so `part` stays queued. Off: every such not-`same` stays queued.

third.about: 0201 (identity.third): a Haiku `same` still queued after both opinions and the chain guard, for a reason listed here, is asked alias-v2 (alias3: each side's known facts, the accounts naming it, four posts with wider windows). Its `same` >= same_min_conf merges ('third', past the chain guard's two-groups rule, never past 6 names a cluster); its answer in apart_relations >= apart_min_conf keeps the pair apart; anything else stays queued with it. Measured 2026-11-14, blind, held out: chain-held pairs, alias-v2 `same` >= 0.8: 76/77 right (98.7%, Wilson 93.0-99.8%), it decides 77 of 88; weak first answers (below_bar): `same` >= 0.85 12/15, so below_bar is not listed; `apart` never measured (alias-v2 said it once in 168): off.
third.haiku_only: owner 2026-11-16 (v10.19.1, 0209): the worker never uses Sonnet, only Haiku. The weak first `same` (below_bar) and the version-held classes were automatic only with Sonnet (alias4, below); with Haiku they failed the bar (alias-v2 weak `same` 12/15), so they are no longer listed: they stay queued again, never merged or kept apart by a Haiku answer. The Sonnet rows below are kept as the record of what was measured.
third.version: v10.18 round 5: version-held pairs asked alias-v2 with Sonnet (alias4): `same` >= 0.9 67/67 right (Wilson 94.6-100%) on 140 held-out items (28 of 60, then 39 of 80, every one labelled); >= 0.8 42/45: the bar is 0.9; apart not listed (11/11, too few).

below_bar.off: Sonnet only; removed by the owner 2026-11-16

third.apart_about: v10.18 round 4: Sonnet's not-`same` on the weak class (alias4) at >= 0.7: 36/36 right (Wilson 90.4-100%) on 160 held-out weak items (all its not-`same` answers labelled: 120 + 40 more); below 0.7 it is 24/32. Chain-held: alias-v2 said apart once, never measured: no row. Version-held with Sonnet: same >= 0.9 28/28 (low 87.9%), >= 0.8 42/45; apart 11/11 (low 74.1%): not listed.
third.below_bar: v10.18 round 3: a weak first `same` (< 0.85, no second opinion) asked alias-v2 with Sonnet (kind alias4, `models`): `same` >= 0.8 67/68 right (98.5%, Wilson 92.1-99.7%) on 120 held-out items, the second 60 alone 34/34; it fires on 68 of 120. Sonnet's not-`same` 31/32 (Wilson low 84.3%): apart stays off. Haiku's alias-v2 on the same class: 12/15, off.

models.about: v10.18: the model a kind is asked with when not the worker's own --model (the server names it on each leased task; identity.model_for). Owner 2026-11-16 (v10.19.1): only Haiku, ever: alias4's Sonnet routing removed, and model_for refuses to name any model that is not a Haiku.

facts.about: 0184 (markx/entity_facts.py): identity facts. on: the readers read them and the stage writes them (makers from stated mentions; the facts of a settled collision answer); place: a bare name's new mention placed in a sense by rule (stated maker, shared source or co-named entity), else marked wait and its entity asked; split: a split two runs agree on becomes sense entities with their mentions pinned (else queued for the owner, as before); backfill: bare names with 2+ posts and no facts are asked, cap a run. Off until the switch-on bars of 0184 are met on frozen sets (plan/issues/0184). Measured 2026-11-14: place (rule 1, the stated maker) 53/54 (98.1%, Wilson low 90.2%) on held-out server collisions: on (it acts only once `on` is); rule_context 140/171: off; rule_handle: no person rows on the copies (18 rows, all orgs): off, unmeasured; split 54/54: off until the owner switches `on`.

repairs.about: 0164 (markx/entity_repair.py): the identity repairs each run. org_family: a product family merged into an org is cut apart (automatic redirects undone; never the owner's). reparent: a version whose family is an org gets a family entity. families: families differing only by their maker's name or brand merge, then their same versions. (suffix merges dropped in v10.18, 0203: 0 merges of 11 candidates on the copy.) shown: the name and type shown, by evidence. product_accounts (0164 B): an org-typed name that is a family's maker in front of the family's name merges into the family.

timeline.about: 0165 (markx/rename.py; the components rule dropped in v10.18, 0203: 26 of 60 right). renames: two entities of one maker, one older, sharing an own address, a 'formerly' sentence or the new one's post naming the old, are asked (rename-v1) and Haiku's `renamed` queued for the owner, never merged by itself (rename_cap questions a run).
timeline.stops_about: 0165 C (markx/stops.py, stop-v1): `stops` on: a story is a stop on a thing's line when its stop-v1 answer says it is about the thing (else, unasked, by its share of the members), the rest shown as only naming it; `stop_types` on: each stop shows what happened to the thing (launch, weights, benchmark...), off: the answers are kept and not shown.
timeline.by_reading_about: 0220 (timeline.named_only): a post whose role says it is about the thing but whose reading is a round-up, or whose main event (object, actors, headline) never names it, only names it (never the birth, a release, the first outside mention or a month's lead). Measured 2026-11-17 on 20 random things of the last 30 days, frozen before reading, three blind judges: served 17/20 pass, with the rule 17/20; preferred 5, the served 6, same 9: no gain, off.
timeline.version_line_about: 0220 (timeline.version_lines, the order graph.next_version_edges joins posts by): a family's versions on one line on the entity page. Measured 2026-11-17 on the server's families, two blind labellers per version (a real version of which line, its number), a link right when both stops are real versions of one line in the labelled order: dev 89/91 (97.8%, Wilson 92.3-99.4); held out 1 (40 families, frozen) 27/28 (96.4%, 82.3-99.4); held out 2 (80 families, frozen) 80/88 (90.9%, 83.1-95.3): under the bar, off (the line next_version had: 78.8-84.3%; graph.next_version_edges uses the new line). Its failures: a product generation ('40 Series') read as a version, a guess at the next number with many posts, a dot-left-out rule folding a well-named 11 into a rare 1.1 (fixed after, in-sample 82/88). 0234 (v10.25): product lines, release order, a stop only when its maker announced it (or, the maker silent here, 2+ voices report its release; a leak never), dated by that, series and phrases off. NOT measured on a fresh set (no real copy; the owner stopped server requests 2026-11-19); a dev check on 0220's cached 11-17 pages and labels (in sample, no dates): links 143 right, 2 split, 0 wrong of 145; recall 73% / 32% / 33%: off.
timeline.measured: plan/issues/0165-a-things-timeline.md, Built and measured (v10.23): stops (about) 97.0% [93.5-98.6] on 198 held-out answers, on; stop words 71-73% on held-out stops, off; analysis 40/60 = 67% [54-77], off

chains.about: 0219 (markx/graph.py, chain-v1): two stories that are both stops of one thing (stored stop answers saying about), the later at most 30 days after and among the 3 stops after the earlier, are asked how they relate (Haiku, two runs; an edge only when both agree), stored as story-to-story mx_connections (rule chain_stops), closed never deleted. `on`: the plan job asks and syncs, the story page shows its chain; `shown`: the relations the reader sees (the others are stored, not shown: under their bar).
chains.measured: plan/issues/0219-story-chains.md: no relation passes the bar (point 97%, Wilson lower 90%) on held-out sets; same_release (both runs agree) 53/55 = 96.4% [87.7-99.0] (round 1), 92/98 = 93.9% [87.3-97.2] (round 2, final guide); the others 33-75%. Every edge is stored (the input of 0217's one-release row), none is shown.
chains.one_row_measured: 0236 (markx/news.py rows_of, headlines): the stories a current same_release edge joins are one News row, named by the launch. Off: 0219's stored labels re-scored under the owner's 2026-11-19 one-release rules (no new labels, no new Haiku): round 1 55/55 = 100% [Wilson 93.5], round 2 95/98 = 96.9% [91.4]: round 2's point is under 97% (the maker's AMA 17 and 28 days later, still open, counted out; a many-model index joined to impressions).

relations.about: 0220 (markx/graph.py, section 4): the relations an entities answer states between two of its own mentions (ent-v3 / ent-v4.2 `relations`), as entity edges (rule `stated`, the posts stating each its evidence) shown on both entities' pages. Measured 2026-11-17 on the 11-05 server copy's 5,541 ent-v3 answers (1,164 relations; frozen samples, two blind labellers, a referee on splits): based_on 95/95 (100%, Wilson 96.1-100): on; released as stated 87/90 (96.7%, 90.7-98.9), and with the thing's own mention naming the same maker (graph.corroborated) 89/90 (98.9%, 94.0-99.8) on 90 more held out: on, corroborated; acquired 25/25 (Wilson 86.7: too few rows for the bar): off; part_of 63/70 (90.0%): off; partnered_with 86/106 (81.1%): off. ent-v5 does not ask for relations (0223: asking them failed); its own fields give `released` (0224, `derived` below).

derived.about: 0224 (graph.derived, plan/issues/0223 section 0224): read from ent-v5's own fields, no relation asked; each also needs its relation on above. Measured 2026-11-17 on frozen held-out sets of the 11-05 server copy (ent-v5 read by Haiku as the worker asks it; two blind labellers with 0220's guide, a referee on splits). released = the reading's subject (model, product, software) whose `maker` names an org or person the reading lists as subject or actor: held out 2 175/180 (97.2%, Wilson 93.7-98.8; random posts 36/36): on. (Any thing with its maker anywhere in the reading: held out 1 138/200, 69.0%.) based_on = the subject based on each `predecessor`: held out 1 20/33 (60.6%, 43.7-75.3): off (a predecessor is mostly what the subject replaces or is compared with).

derive.about: 0234 (graph.plan_derive, kind derive, guide derive-v1): each (subject, predecessor) pair one ent-v5 reading names in one window asked once whether the post says the subject is made from the predecessor; `derived` (all `runs` answers) alone lets derived based_on write the edge. ask: the jobs process plans the questions. Measured 2026-11-19 on a frozen held-out set (1,500 base-cue posts of the 11-05 copy read by ent-v5: 44 pairs; two blind labellers with 0220's guide, a referee on 2 splits, 8 decoys): derived on one run 15/16 (93.8%, Wilson 71.7-98.9), all of 3 runs 14/14 (78.5-100), the majority of 3 16/16 (80.6-100); recall 14-16 of the 25 labelled based_on (0224's rule alone: 20/33). Under the bar's Wilson lower bound (too few pairs: 36+ needed): the edge off; ask on (v10.25 integrator: the server's own pairs are collected for the next measure, no edge written).

families.about: 0230 (markx/identity.py: family_makers, family_stem, namesakes; entity_repair.family_home for the data made before). maker: a versioned thing whose stated maker is none of its family's (the maker its members state most, and any a fifth of them state) is a thing of its own maker, based_on the family (edge rule family_maker), never a member. stem: a family key naming one of a family's versions or variants is that family. namesakes: a relation's side whose post gives it another maker than its entity's is no evidence. Built 2026-11-19, NOT measured on real data (the scratch server was wiped and real-data testing stopped that day): off until a frozen sample of >= 150 memberships passes 97% / Wilson 90%.
